description: Whether a phone number has a WhatsApp account, and its WhatsApp id. A number without an account is a normal answer (`registered: false`), not an error. Group: Numbers. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

phone.description: The phone number in international format with its country code, e.g. `+14155550123`. Spaces, dashes, brackets, a leading `00` or the WhatsApp id form (`14155550123@c.us`) are accepted.

name: get_v1_number_check
